decision_reason: Both platforms strongly support the unchanged coding splice. Illumina samples the noncoding isoform, but no complete T2 deletion-allele transcript path or coding consequence is observed.
dna_only: The deletion is intronic in all inspected coding transcripts but removes 35 nt from an exon of processed noncoding transcript ENST00000588024, which has no CDS.
epitope_message: Not predicted because the observed platform difference is noncoding and no mutant CDS exists.
interpretation: This is a real platform difference in transcript evidence: short reads detect a noncoding isoform absent from the ONT slice. It does not change the coding protein or vaccine-peptide pool.
limitation: The complete noncoding isoform is supported in T1, before the acquired T2 DNA event; two T2 upstream-junction reads alone do not establish a mutant noncoding transcript.

platform_comparison.conclusion: Both platforms strongly support the unchanged KEAP1 coding splice. Illumina alone samples a noncoding processed isoform that overlaps the DNA deletion, but no complete mutant RNA path is observed.
